releaseNotes: Added an explicit, off-by-default Help → Share anonymous MCP usage setting for desktop operation reporting, separate from local-agent permission.

Reports fixed operation and outcome categories, changed-edit results, preview kinds, and verified artifact persistence without artwork, scripts, filenames, paths, agent names, or persistent identifiers.

Hosted automation now distinguishes validation, previews, project operations, artifact actions, failures, cancellations, generated exports, and retrieval storage. Desktop MCP separately reports verified disk saves.
Reporting has no offline queue, retry, or backfill. CLI and standalone use remain untracked; PixelWall 0.5.0 and earlier do not have the desktop reporting control.
Updated the web editor, standalone browser edition, CLI, and desktop guidance for the expanded automation workflow.
